description: Requires sign-in. Get live products, prices and availability at one bookable operator for specific dates and party size. operator_id comes from bk_search_operators; check_in and check_out are YYYY-MM-DD dates. Returns bookable products with product_id, price, max_guests and an available flag (or, for some caravan parks, an availability grid). The product_id and price are the inputs to bk_cart_add.
name: bk_operator_availability
title: Live park availability and prices
